components.css: .ds-tape { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 1rem; background: #ede8df; } .ds-head { display: grid; justify-items: center; width: 20rem; padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 14px 14px 6px 6px; background: #0f3b30; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px rgb(15 59 48 / 55%); position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-slot { display: block; width: calc(100% - 2.5rem); height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgb(0 0 0 / 45%); } .ds-paper { position: relative; width: 17rem; margin-top: -4px; padding: 0.5rem 1.6rem 1rem; background: #fbfaf6; color: #0f3b30; box-shadow: 0 18px 32px -20px rgb(15 59 48 / 45%); font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.5; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-paper::before, .ds-paper::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 10px; background: radial-gradient(circle, #ede8df 2.5px, transparent 3px) center top / 10px 16px repeat-y; } .ds-paper::before { left: 4px; } .ds-paper::after { right: 4px; } .ds-entry { border-bottom: 2px dotted rgb(15 59 48 / 40%); } .ds-entry summary { display: grid; gap: 0.1rem; padding: 0.85rem 0; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-entry summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-entry summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f3b30; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-entry:first-child { margin-inline: -0.6rem; padding-inline: 0.6rem; background: rgb(15 59 48 / 6%); } .ds-line { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; } .ds-ok, .ds-reject { display: grid; margin-top: 0.35rem; } .ds-ok strong, .ds-reject strong { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-reject { color: #8a2a1e; } .ds-checks { margin: 0 0 0.85rem; padding-left: 1rem; list-style: '- '; opacity: 0.85; }

narrative.overview:
Arqueo looks like the paper journal roll of a cash register that never gets torn off. The page is warm cream paper taken from the logo, set in deep green ink; every payment prints as a line, approved or refused, and stays on the record. The voice is a calm geometric sans; the evidence is a receipt-printer mono that appears only where data is being printed.

Density is relaxed and editorial: one wide column with a 1200px measure, generous vertical rhythm between sections, and tables ruled like a ledger rather than boxed into cards. Ornament is limited to the material of the journal itself: the print head, its slot, the punched feed holes, the dotted tear lines between entries and the torn end of the roll. Colour does very little work; the single non-brand hue is reserved for refusals.

The system rejects the fintech split hero with a product screenshot and three feature cards. The proof is the tape, not a dashboard image.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper ground, deep green ink, one oxblood note for rejections only.
Jost for every word of voice; Spline Sans Mono for printed data and inline code.
Ledger tables with hairline green rules instead of cards.
One full-bleed green band per page, used for the mechanism.
The journal tape (print head, perforated stock, torn end) as the signature object.
Soft, green-tinted ambient shadows only on physical objects.

rules.name: The Oxblood Is a Verdict Rule
rules.body: Oxblood marks a payment the account refused. It never appears on buttons, links, headings, alerts unrelated to a refusal, or decoration.

rules.name: The One Drench Rule
rules.body: A page carries at most one full-bleed Ledger Green band, reserved for explaining the mechanism. Every other section sits on Cream Ground.

rules.name: The Printer Speaks Mono Rule
rules.body: Spline Sans Mono is for printed data (tape entries, hashes, amounts) and inline `code`. Headings, buttons, navigation and prose are always Jost.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any column of amounts or times uses tabular numerals so the ledger lines up.

rules.name: The Only Objects Cast Shadows Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the thing is a physical object (button, printer, paper). Sections, tables and text blocks never get one.

dos: **Do** set every surface on Cream Ground (#ede8df) with Ledger Green (#0f3b30) ink; use Tape Stock (#fbfaf6) only for the journal paper.
**Do** reserve Oxblood (#8a2a1e) for refused payments, per The Oxblood Is a Verdict Rule.
**Do** present matrices, comparisons and payment lists as ruled ledger tables with tabular numerals.
**Do** print payment data (amounts, hashes, rules, signers) in Spline Sans Mono, and everything else in Jost at weight 400 or 500.
**Do** show rejected attempts alongside approved ones wherever payments are listed; the record is never trimmed.
**Do** mark unfinished content with the dashed pending slot and a working alternative.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by stopping print animations and showing the final state.
donts: **Don't** build a split hero with a product screenshot and a row of three feature cards.
**Don't** use oxblood, red or any warning hue for anything other than a refusal.
**Don't** add a second full-bleed green band to a page.
**Don't** set headings, buttons or prose in the mono face.
**Don't** put shadows on sections, tables or text blocks, or use black or hard offset shadows.
**Don't** add ornament beyond the journal's own material (print head, feed holes, dotted tear lines, torn edge).
**Don't** carry the Scaffold Stellar template styles into new Arqueo screens.
